description:
Look up a diagnostic trouble code (P0340, C1105, U1000, or an old Nissan blink code like 34)
in one car's manual and return where its diagnosis starts: page, title, and the parent bookmarks
('within'). A manual covering several engines or systems has one diagnosis per variant, so check
'within' (e.g. "QG18DE" vs "QR25DE") against the car. 'manual' is required: a manual from
find_manuals, or its model folder to cover all years (listed newest year first).
name: lookup_dtc
title: Look up a trouble code
